prose: Microsoft officially unveiled its redesigned Copilot 'super app', bundling AI chat, coding and agents into a single interface after teasing it last month. As part of the launch, Scout - the AI personal assistant introduced at Build earlier this year - is rebranded as Autopilot.

The new app has three tabs: Home, Code and Autopilot. Home merges Copilot Chat and Cowork as the default landing experience, and Microsoft plans a Today feature inside it: a personalized dashboard for important emails, meeting requests and more.
highlights: Microsoft's Copilot 'super app' is official: chat, coding and agents in one.
Scout, the personal assistant from Build, is rebranded Autopilot.
Home merges Copilot Chat and Cowork as the default view.
A Today dashboard for emails and meetings is planned.
